    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletions in src/index/base.cpp and base.h mechanically remove snapshot-awareness from the BaseIndex class.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Base index modifications are mechanical downstream adjustments following the removal of background chainstates."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/interfaces/chain.h mechanically strip AssumeUTXO hooks from the interface wrapper.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not an IPC architecture change; interface updates follow from validation changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits under src/kernel/ strip AssumeUTXO parameters and chain types as part of the broader feature removal.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change the kernel API boundary or project scope, only tracking validation deletions."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches fee estimation and validation headers only as incidental cleanup, not mempool policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a mempool change."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/net_processing.cpp delete background-sync downloading logic and hooks.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Net processing changes mechanically follow the removal of background validation sync."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removing loadtxoutset from src/rpc/blockchain.cpp mechanically follows the removal of the underlying feature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC method deletion follows directly from the removal of AssumeUTXO rather than changes to RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes remove feature-specific functional and fuzz tests rather than changing test runner infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deleting feature_assumeutxo.py and related tests follows the removal of the feature itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor edits in src/init.cpp reject snapshot datadirs on startup, following validation changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter core utility or logging infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Substantially modifies src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, and src/node/blockstorage.cpp to eliminate multi-chainstate infrastructure and AssumeUTXO snapshot sync.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Collapsing ChainstateManager back to a single active chainstate removes pervasive synchronization complexity across validation, block storage, and cache management. As the description notes, supporting concurrent chainstates forces pervasive special-casing across block download, cache allocation, database lifetimes, and prune heights. Resolving whether to maintain this architectural burden or streamline validation has durable strategic value for the subsystem."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor edits to src/wallet/wallet.cpp and deletion of wallet_assumeutxo.py follow removal of multi-chainstate notifications.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not substantively modify wallet internals or wallet user features."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,

    "leverage": 2
  }
}
